references.text: Micah warns against resisting God's Spirit, which can be seen as a parallel to the warning against speaking against the Holy Spirit in Matthew 12:32.

This verse refers to the Holy Spirit who had not yet been given because Jesus had not yet been glorified, underscoring the significance and holy nature of the Holy Spirit, related to the warning against mocking the Holy Spirit in Matthew 12:32.
The warning against falling away after receiving knowledge of the truth and the Holy Spirit, which reflects the seriousness of mocking the Holy Spirit as mentioned in Matthew 12:32.

This verse speaks of a stricter punishment for those who have trampled the Son of God underfoot, treated the blood of the covenant as unholy, and insulted the Spirit of grace, corresponding to the gravity of mocking the Holy Spirit in Matthew 12:32.
